title: Building an AXI Out-of-Order Scoreboard
description: Build an AXI monitor and scoreboard that handle out-of-order responses and multiple outstanding same-ID bursts.

steps.title: Reconstruct read bursts
steps.instructions: Complete `axi_monitor.sv` so it queues requests per ID and captures every accepted response beat through RLAST.

steps.title: Match responses by ID
steps.instructions: Complete `axi_scoreboard.sv` so different IDs may finish out of order while each individual ID remains ordered.

steps.title: Exercise reordering
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` and confirm ID 2 may finish before ID 1 without hiding beat-count, response-code, or RLAST failures.
